title.text: Where each age group is moving: high-churn regions gain people in their twenties
subtitle: Net internal migration as % of each age group's population a year, pooled 2018–24. Blue = gaining, red = losing (darkest shades = ±6% or more).
England and Wales ITL2 regions, sorted from highest to lowest job reallocation rate (2018–24). International migration excluded.
Sources: ONS internal migration estimates (England and Wales); ONS mid-year population estimates; ONS Longitudinal Business Database; authors' calculations.
